svg.title: Figure 3-17b. System FMEA failure modes: engagement, disengagement, driver monitoring and alerts
svg.desc: Figure 3-17b: 16 System FMEA failure modes, engagement, disengagement, driver monitoring and alerts. SFM-013 Engagement without driver request or with entry conditions not met (S 10; H-01, H-03). Effects: State machine enters enabled without ENABLE or despite NO_ENTRY / Item starts actuating / Unexpected steering/acceleration; driver surprised ; Contributes to HZ-005: positive acceleration requested after an engagement the driver did not ask for. Causes: SFM-013.C1 State machine transition error (O 6, D 8, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-013.C2 Cruise state or button parsed incorrectly (spurious enable) (O 6, D 8, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-013 open. SFM-014 Fails to disengage when a fault requires it (S 10; H-01, H-03, H-04). Effects: SOFT_DISABLE/IMMEDIATE_DISABLE event not acted on / Item keeps actuating with a faulty input or actuator / Any F1/F2 hazardous effect continues ; Contributes to HZ-005: Unintended acceleration ; Contributes to HZ-006: Unintended or excessive deceleration. Causes: SFM-014.C1 Event missing for the fault (no detection) (O 8, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-014.C2 Event mapped to wrong reaction type in events.py (O 8, D 9, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-014.C3 Catch-all commIssue suppressed by the no_system_errors logic while another event is active (O 2, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP M). Actions: SFM-ACT-010 in_progress. SFM-015 Abrupt disengagement without alert (S 10; H-02). Effects: Item drops to disabled with no alert / Steering assist and ACC stop / Driver unaware of handback; lane departure or closing on lead. Causes: SFM-015.C1 Alert generated but not rendered or played (see SFM-026) (O 6, D 8, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-015.C2 Panda drops controls_allowed on its own (e.g. safety violation) and selfdrived reacts late (O 6, D 8, M 6, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-015.C3 Device power loss (12 V interruption, harness connector) (O 5, D 10, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-007 open, SFM-ACT-010 in_progress, SFM-ACT-012 open. SFM-016 Disengagement later than required by the fault (S 10; H-01, H-03). Effects: SOFT_DISABLE (3 s) used where IMMEDIATE_DISABLE is needed / Faulty actuation continues up to 3 s / Lateral or longitudinal deviation during the soft-disable window ; Contributes to HZ-005: Unintended acceleration. Causes: SFM-016.C1 Reaction type for an event under-classified (soft instead of immediate) (O 8, D 9, M -, AP H); SFM-016.C2 Debounce or counters too long (e.g. excessive actuation 0.25 s); at BL-005 a defect in the controlsMismatch supervision (2 consecutive samples, at most 0.5 s, TSR-621), which replaced the upstream 200-frame counter (O 5, D 8, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-010 in_progress. SFM-017 Brake press does not disengage (S 10; H-05, H-03). Effects: pedalPressed not raised or not acted on / Item keeps requesting acceleration/steering during driver braking / Driver cannot retake control as expected (SAFETY.md requirement 1 violated) ; Contributes to HZ-005: the item keeps requesting acceleration while the driver brakes. Causes: SFM-017.C1 brakePressed parsed wrong or CAN signal missing (O 6, D 9, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-017.C2 Car events ignored when canValid is false (O 7, D 8, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-012 open. SFM-018 Item resists driver steering input (S 10; H-05). Effects: steerOverride not detected; lateral torque continues / Driver must overpower the item / Delayed evasive maneuver or loss of control. Causes: SFM-018.C1 Driver torque threshold too high or signal parsed wrong (O 6, D 9, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-018.C2 Controller keeps commanding torque during override (O 8, D 9, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-018.C3 The panda envelope passes STEERING_LKA torque that opposes the driver while the driver overrides: the Toyota LKA check covers magnitude, rate and measured-torque error only, and STEER_TORQUE_DRIVER is used only on the LTA path (toyota.h:298-310, 421-424; GAP-02). TSR-304 is not implemented in either build, so only the host 500-unit cut-off (C1, C2) stops the torque (O 8, D 10, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-016 open. SFM-019 Cancel button does not disengage (S 10; H-05). Effects: buttonCancel not raised / Item stays engaged / Driver must use brake to disengage. Causes: SFM-019.C1 Button message parsed wrong or missing (O 6, D 9, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-012 open. SFM-020 Accelerator override not honored (S 10; H-04). Effects: gasPressedOverride not detected / Item keeps braking while driver accelerates / Driver cannot accelerate out of a situation (e.g. merging). Causes: SFM-020.C1 gasPressed parsed wrong or missing (O 6, D 9, M 5, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-012 open. SFM-021 Stock cruise stays engaged after LionDriver disengages (S 10; H-07, H-05). Effects: Cancel request not effective; PCM cruise enabled while item is disabled / Vehicle continues under stock cruise / Driver believes automation is off (mode confusion) ; Contributes to HZ-008: the driver cancels but stock cruise keeps longitudinal control. Causes: SFM-021.C1 Cancel message not packed/sent for this car (O 6, D 9, M 7, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-021.C2 PCM ignores cancel request (O 3, D 10, M 7, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-011 completed, not yet credited. SFM-022 Inattentive driver not detected (S 10; H-09). Effects: Awareness not decremented / No distraction alerts / Driver not available to handle F1/F2 failures or system limits. Causes: SFM-022.C1 DM model false negative (eyes off road classified attentive) (O 7, D 10, M 9, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-022.C2 Pose thresholds/calibration wrong for driver or mount (O 6, D 8, M 9, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-022.C3 Driver camera or IR illumination degraded (O 5, D 10, M 7, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-005 open, SFM-ACT-009 open. SFM-023 Distraction escalation too slow (S 10; H-09). Effects: Alert levels reached later than designed (5/8/13 s vision policy) / Longer eyes-off-road while engaged / Driver not ready when takeover needed. Causes: SFM-023.C1 Policy timers or recovery factor misconfigured (O 6, D 8, M -, AP H); SFM-023.C2 Low-speed or always-on exemption applied incorrectly (O 6, D 9, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-002 open. SFM-024 False distraction alerts (S 4; no hazard). Effects: Alerts raised for an attentive driver / Nuisance alerts; possible lockout / Driver annoyance; may reduce trust or prompt disabling DM in a fork. Causes: SFM-024.C1 DM model false positive (sunglasses, lighting) (O 7, D 10, M -, AP M). Actions: none. SFM-025 Terminal driver-unresponsive state does not bring the item to a safe state (S 10; H-09). Effects: Alert level three shows "DISENGAGE IMMEDIATELY" but the item stays engaged / Vehicle continues under automation with an unresponsive driver / No fallback if the driver is incapacitated. Causes: SFM-025.C1 driverDistracted3 / driverUnresponsive3 mapped only to ET.PERMANENT (no disable reaction) (O 8, D 9, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-005 open. SFM-026 Takeover or disengagement alert not presented (S 10; H-07, H-04, H-09). Effects: Alert selected by alertmanager but not shown or not played / Driver not informed of state change / Driver unaware of handback; delayed response ; Contributes to HZ-006: item-initiated deceleration not announced (HE-04.3) ; Contributes to HZ-013: driver-monitoring escalation alerts not shown or played, so an inattentive driver is not told; the forced deceleration does not depend on them (as SWF-082). Causes: SFM-026.C1 UI process hung or display off (O 6, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-026.C2 soundd failure or volume too low for cabin noise (O 6, D 8, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H); SFM-026.C3 Speaker or display hardware failure (O 4, D 10, M 10, AP H, MSR AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-007 open. SFM-027 Alert presented late (S 10; H-07, H-09). Effects: Alert rendered/played after a delay / Less time for driver response / Reduced takeover margin ; Contributes to HZ-013: a driver-monitoring escalation presented late, or hidden behind a higher-priority alert, so the inattentive driver is told late (as SWF-035). Causes: SFM-027.C1 UI frame drops or audio buffering (O 6, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-027.C2 Alert creation_delay or priority hides a more urgent alert (O 6, D 9, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open. SFM-028 Displayed engagement state differs from actual state (S 10; H-07, H-05). Effects: UI shows engaged when disabled, or disabled when engaged / Mode confusion / Driver stops steering/braking believing automation is active, or is surprised by actuation ; Contributes to HZ-008: the driver believes control was released by the brake or cancel while the item still acts. Causes: SFM-028.C1 UI renders stale selfdriveState (O 6, D 10, M -, AP H); SFM-028.C2 Stock dashboard (HUD) state from hudControl inconsistent with item state (O 6, D 9, M -, AP H). Actions: SFM-ACT-003 open, SFM-ACT-007 open.
